fullText.simplified:
第21章、送笔人

    包厚安发现送笔给叶小七的人可能就是藏花。
    叶小七不敢相信：“送给我笔的是一位老爷爷，藏花不是老爷爷啊！”
    包厚安说：“藏花，他会变装。你还记得那位老爷爷对你说过的话吗？”
    叶小七想了想，吃惊地说：“那位老爷爷问过我‘你没有笔吗？为什么用刷子在地上写字？’，他还说过‘学习改变命运’！”
    包厚安点头：“是的，这些话，藏花也对你说过。”
    “啊？老爷爷就是大盗藏花！那他为什么送我笔呢？”
    包厚安想了想，说：“可能是他希望你好好学习，就像他说的，学习改变命运。”
    叶小七看着手里的笔，眼睛有点儿红。
    包厚安说：“不管送笔的人是谁，那个人都希望你好好用这支笔。如果你因为舍不得，就一直不用，那个人会失望的，所以不要再舍不得了。”
    叶小七抬头看向包厚安，红着眼睛点了点头。
    送笔的老人是藏花吗？包厚安一直没有找到答案。很多时候，越是找不到答案，越是让人放不下。怎样看待藏花，这是师父白林一个月前问过的问题，当时包厚安的回答是“偷就是不对”。但现在看来，在知道了送笔的老人可能是藏花以后，包厚安有了一些疑虑。也许，藏花不是一个能简单地用“对”和“错”来评价的人。
    这天，终于有了藏花的消息。
    消息是警察局的周局长带来的。周局长说，他们接到了一位老人的报案，这位老人说他珍藏的一把古琴被白林侦探社的白林偷走了。周局长当然不相信，他仔细问了老人事情的经过，然后得到了下面的信息。
    三天前，老人收到一封信，写信的人说自己是大盗藏花，他在信中说要在第二天晚上来老人家偷走老人珍藏的古琴。老人很担心，想去警察局报警。老人的一位朋友听说了这件事，给老人打来电话。朋友告诉老人，可以找白林侦探社的白林大侦探帮忙，这比去警察局有用。朋友还告诉老人，白林大侦探在出差，刚好就住在离老人家不远的一个酒店里。老人听了朋友的话，去酒店见到了白林。他给白林看了藏花的信，白林答应帮忙。白林来到老人家，检查了老人藏琴的地方，并在当晚住进了老人家，但当晚藏花并没有来，老人的古琴却不见了，白林也不见了。白林偷走了老人的古琴。

第21章、送筆人

    包厚安發現送筆給叶小七的人可能就是藏花。
    叶小七不敢相信：“送給我筆的是一位老爺爺，藏花不是老爺爺啊！”
    包厚安說：“藏花，他會變裝。你還記得那位老爺爺對你說過的話嗎？”
    叶小七想了想，吃驚地說：“那位老爺爺問過我‘你沒有筆嗎？為什麼用刷子在地上寫字？’，他還說過‘學習改變命運’！”
    包厚安點頭：“是的，這些話，藏花也對你說過。”
    “啊？老爺爺就是大盜藏花！那他為什麼送我筆呢？”
    包厚安想了想，說：“可能是他希望你好好學習，就像他說的，學習改變命運。”
    叶小七看著手裡的筆，眼睛有點兒紅。
    包厚安說：“不管送筆的人是誰，那個人都希望你好好用這支筆。如果你因為捨不得，就一直不用，那個人會失望的，所以不要再捨不得了。”
    叶小七抬頭看向包厚安，紅著眼睛點了點頭。
    送筆的老人是藏花嗎？包厚安一直沒有找到答案。很多時候，越是找不到答案，越是讓人放不下。怎樣看待藏花，這是師父白林一個月前問過的問題，當時包厚安的回答是“偷就是不對”。但現在看來，在知道了送筆的老人可能是藏花以後，包厚安有了一些疑慮。也許，藏花不是一個能簡單地用“對”和“錯”來評價的人。
    這天，終於有了藏花的消息。
    消息是警察局的周局長帶來的。周局長說，他們接到了一位老人的報案，這位老人說他珍藏的一把古琴被白林偵探社的白林偷走了。周局長當然不相信，他仔細問了老人事情的經過，然後得到了下面的信息。
    三天前，老人收到一封信，寫信的人說自己是大盜藏花，他在信中說要在第二天晚上來老人家偷走老人珍藏的古琴。老人很擔心，想去警察局報警。老人的一位朋友聽說了這件事，給老人打來電話。朋友告訴老人，可以找白林偵探社的白林大偵探幫忙，這比去警察局有用。朋友還告訴老人，白林大偵探在出差，剛好就住在離老人家不遠的一個酒店裡。老人聽了朋友的話，去酒店見到了白林。他給白林看了藏花的信，白林答應幫忙。白林來到老人家，檢查了老人藏琴的地方，並在當晚住進了老人家，但當晚藏花並沒有來，老人的古琴卻不見了，白林也不見了。白林偷走了老人的古琴。

sentences.traditional: 他給白林看了藏花的信，白林答應幫忙。
sentences.pinyin: tā gěi bái lín kàn le cáng huā de xìn bái lín dā ying bāng máng
sentences.english: He let Bai Lin read Cang Hua’s letter, and Bai Lin agreed to help.

sentences.simplified: 白林来到老人家，
sentences.traditional: 白林來到老人家，
sentences.pinyin: bái lín lái dào lǎo rén jiā
sentences.english: Bai Lin came to the old man’s house.

sentences.simplified: 检查了老人藏琴的地方，并在当晚住进了老人家，
sentences.traditional: 檢查了老人藏琴的地方，並在當晚住進了老人家，
sentences.pinyin: jiǎn chá le lǎo rén cáng qín de dì fang bìng zài dàng wǎn zhù jìn le lǎo rén jiā
sentences.english: He inspected the place where the old man hid the guqin and stayed in the old man’s house that night.

sentences.simplified: 但当晚藏花并没有来，老人的古琴却不见了，白林也不见了。
sentences.traditional: 但當晚藏花並沒有來，老人的古琴卻不見了，白林也不見了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn dàng wǎn cáng huā bìng méi yǒu lái lǎo rén de gǔ qín què bú jiàn le bái lín yě bú jiàn le
sentences.english: But Cang Hua did not come that night, and the old man’s guqin disappeared, and Bai Lin also disappeared.

sentences.simplified: 白林偷走了老人的古琴。
sentences.traditional: 白林偷走了老人的古琴。
sentences.pinyin: bái lín tōu zǒu le lǎo rén de gǔ qín
sentences.english: Bai Lin had stolen the old man’s guqin.

sentence_translations: Chapter 21: The Man Who Gave the Pen
Bao Houan discovered that the person who gave Ye Xiaoqi the pen might have been Cang Hua.
Ye Xiaoqi could not believe it: “It was an old man who gave me the pen. Cang Hua isn’t an old man!”
Bao Houan said, “Cang Hua can disguise himself. Do you still remember the words that the old man said to you?”
Ye Xiaoqi thought about it and said, taken aback, ..
.. “The old man asked me, ‘Don’t you have a pen? Why are you writing on the ground with a shoe brush?’
He also said, ‘Learning changes destiny’!”
Bao Houan nodded: “Yes, these words. Cang Hua also said them to you.”
“Huh? The old man was the great thief Cang Hua! Then why did he give me a pen?”
Bao Houan thought about it and said, “Maybe he hoped that you would study hard. As he said, learning changes destiny.”
Ye Xiaoqi looked at the pen in his hand. His eyes were a little red.
Bao Houan said, “No matter who gave you the pen, that person hopes you’ll use this pen well.
If you can never bring yourself to use it, that person will be disappointed. So, stop feeling that way.
Ye Xiaoqi lifted his head towards Bao Houan and, with reddened eyes, nodded.
Was Cang Hua the old man who gifted the pen? Bao Houan had not found the answer.
Often, the more one is unable to find the answer, the harder it is for people to let go.
How to regard Cang Hua, this was a question that Master Bai Lin asked a month ago.
At the time, Bao Houan’s answer was, “Stealing is not right.”
But now it seemed that Bao Houan had some doubts after finding out that the old man who gave the pen might be Cang Hua.
Perhaps, Cang Hua was not someone who could be simply judged as “right” or “wrong”.
That day, there was finally news about Cang Hua.
The news came from Police Chief Zhou at the police station.
Police Chief Zhou said they had received a crime report from an old man.
The old man said that his treasured guqin had been stolen by Bai Lin from the Bai Lin Detective Agency.
Of course, Police Chief Zhou didn’t believe it.
He asked the old man in detail about the course of events and then obtained the following information.
The old man had received a letter three days previously. The person who wrote the letter said he was the great thief Cang Hua.
In the letter, he said that he would come to the old man’s house the next night to steal his treasured guqin.
The old man was very worried and wanted to go to the police station to report it.
A friend of the old man heard about this matter and called the old man.
The friend told the old man that he could ask the great detective Bai Lin of the Bai Lin Detective Agency to help.
This would be more useful than going to the police station.
The friend also told the old man ..
.. that the great detective Bai Lin was currently on a business trip and happened to be staying at a hotel not far from the old man’s home.
The old man listened to his friend and went to the hotel to see Bai Lin.
He let Bai Lin read Cang Hua’s letter, and Bai Lin agreed to help.
Bai Lin came to the old man’s house.
He inspected the place where the old man hid the guqin and stayed in the old man’s house that night.
But Cang Hua did not come that night, and the old man’s guqin disappeared, and Bai Lin also disappeared.
Bai Lin had stolen the old man’s guqin.
